stable.notes: MXB FPV v1.1. Drone-centered rider update priority, sparse-rider visibility protection, shared drone reconnect recovery, remote drone/rider smoothing, drone icons on the existing MaxHUD map, and clearer running/latest/downloaded update states. Install on each pilot's PC after closing MX Bikes; saved controls are kept.
